def make_starts_with(phrase):
    def check(text):
        return text.lstrip().startswith(phrase)
    return check

def make_ends_with(phrase):
    def check(text):
        return text.rstrip().endswith(phrase)
    return check

def make_contains(phrase, case_insensitive=True):
    def check(text):
        if case_insensitive:
            return phrase.lower() in text.lower()
        return phrase in text
    return check

def make_not_contains_word(word):
    def check(text):
        import re
        words = re.findall(r'\b\w+\b', text.lower())
        return word.lower() not in words
    return check

def make_not_contains_char(char):
    def check(text):
        return char not in text
    return check

def make_count_sentences(op, n):
    """op: '==', '<=', '>='"""
    import re
    def check(text):
        sentences = re.split(r'(?<=[.!?])\s+', text.strip())
        sentences = [s for s in sentences if len(s.strip()) > 0]
        count = len(sentences)
        if op == '==': return count == n
        if op == '<=': return count <= n
        if op == '>=': return count >= n
        return False
    return check

def make_count_words(op, n):
    def check(text):
        count = len(text.split())
        if op == '==': return count == n
        if op == '<=': return count <= n
        if op == '>=': return count >= n
        return False
    return check

def make_count_paragraphs(op, n):
    def check(text):
        paras = [p for p in text.strip().split('\n\n') if p.strip()]
        count = len(paras)
        if op == '==': return count == n
        if op == '<=': return count <= n
        if op == '>=': return count >= n
        return False
    return check

def make_count_emoji(op, n):
    import re
    emoji_pattern = re.compile(r'[\U0001F600-\U0001F64F\U0001F300-\U0001F5FF\U0001F680-\U0001F6FF\U0001F1E0-\U0001F1FF\U00002702-\U000027B0\U0001F900-\U0001F9FF\U0001FA00-\U0001FA6F\U0001FA70-\U0001FAFF\U00002600-\U000026FF]')
    def check(text):
        count = len(emoji_pattern.findall(text))
        if op == '==': return count == n
        if op == '<=': return count <= n
        if op == '>=': return count >= n
        return False
    return check

def make_regex_match(pattern, should_match=True):
    import re
    compiled = re.compile(pattern)
    def check(text):
        found = bool(compiled.search(text))
        return found == should_match
    return check

    import re
    def check(text):
        lines = [l for l in text.strip().split('\n') if l.strip()]
        if not lines: return False
        bullet = sum(1 for l in lines if re.match(r'^[-•*]\s', l.strip()))
        return bullet / len(lines) >= min_ratio

def make_format_numbered_list(min_items=2):
    import re

        items = re.findall(r'^\d+\.', text, re.MULTILINE)

    def check(text):
        alpha = [c for c in text if c.isalpha()]
        if not alpha: return False
        return sum(1 for c in alpha if c.isupper()) / len(alpha) >= min_ratio
    return check

def make_all_lowercase(min_ratio=0.95):
    def check(text):
        alpha = [c for c in text if c.isalpha()]
        if not alpha: return False
        return sum(1 for c in alpha if c.islower()) / len(alpha) >= min_ratio
    return check

def make_no_contractions():

    def check(text):
        contractions = re.findall(r"\b\w+'(?:t|s|re|ve|ll|d|m)\b", text, re.IGNORECASE)
        return len(contractions) == 0
    return check

def make_compound(*checks):
    """All checks must pass."""
    def check(text):
        return all(c(text) for c in checks)
    return check

    if "check_fn" in prompt_entry and prompt_entry["check_fn"] in CHECK_FNS:

    if "check_type" in prompt_entry:

3	Multi-turn dialogue is the dominant mode of interaction with large language models (LLMs), and system prompts that specify task goals form the foundation of instruction following.
